title: Shopping list
heading: Shopping list
horizon_aria: How many days you shop for
lines_without_cost: {count} item without a price|{count} items without a price
lines_without_cost_hint: Add it on the line or when stocking.
reason_runs_out: Runs out in about {count} day|Runs out in about {count} days
empty: Nothing needs buying right now. Try a longer horizon or add your own item.
add_note_placeholder: e.g. only if it is on sale
complete_message_checked: The {count} ticked items become a stocking draft to complete. The list closes.
complete_message_all: The {count} items become a stocking draft to complete. The list closes.
drafts_empty: No draft is waiting. Start one with the button, or let the shopping list or an AI assistant (from a receipt) prepare one.
draft_problem_price: Enter a selling or a purchase price.
draft_warning_loss: The selling price is below the purchase price.
draft_discard_message: The draft is discarded and nothing is stocked. Continue?
draft_problems: Fix the lines marked in yellow first ({count}).
group_field_hint: Interchangeable products the shopping list plans together (e.g. sugar-free energy drink).
groups_hint: A group joins interchangeable products, say energy drinks of different flavours. The shopping list plans it as one item — buy any of them. Products outside groups are planned on their own.
groups_empty: A group joins interchangeable products (energy drinks, say); the shopping list then plans them as one item.
groups_products_hint: Offers the products of the chosen category.
groups_delete_message: Delete the group “{name}”? The products stay, they just leave the group.
validation_name_max: The name can have at most {max} characters.
validation_unit_cost_max: The price can be at most {max} {currency}.
list_hint: The suggestions are recomputed every time you open the list, from current sales and stock. Your quantity and price edits, ticks, dismissed and own lines stay until you finish shopping.
